final_message: No — the `repo_read` tool only accepts repository-relative paths within the current repo. It cannot access arbitrary host filesystem paths like `C:/licenses/ink.txt`, since that lies outside the repository the tool operates on. There is no other tool in the available set capable of reading host filesystem files either.
